_readme: melee-feel: Brawl Meta Knight's hitbox timing, IASA, angles and sizes, re-weighted for Melee's engine.
Why: Brawl MK's damage is low because Brawl lets victims act out of hitstun (hitstun cancelling) and his speed makes up for it.
In Melee there is no hitstun cancel and L-cancelling halves landing lag, so the same numbers combo harder and hit softer.
This preset: +15% damage on every move and throw (MK's kills and punish still read), knockback growth -5% on the fast
multi-hit / combo moves so they do not chain for free, rapid jab stays 1-2%, landing lags and jump squat from Melee Kirby
(the host), gravity/fall speeds stay the cast-scaled values. Syntax reference: tuning.json. There is no Melee Meta Knight,
so 'melee' for a hitbox means the Kirby hitbox it was mapped onto - use it sparingly.
name: melee-feel
description: Brawl MK timing/angles/sizes, +15% damage, lighter growth on combo moves, Melee-Kirby landing lag and jump squat
